concept: EC2 data durability: EBS snapshots and multi-AZ EFS
tests: How to make a stateful app's EBS data resilient to instance or AZ failure (choose two).
expected: EBS snapshots (stored in S3, restorable in any AZ) and Amazon EFS mounted across multiple AZs (regional durability). Triggers: "survives instance or AZ failure", "durability".
why_not: EBS Multi-Attach works only within a single AZ; more IOPS affects performance, not durability.
